upstream_task.classification: methodologically unsatisfiable, NOT an implementation failure
upstream_task.meaning: the pre-registered gate was implemented and evaluated exactly as frozen; it is the rule itself that cannot satisfy the acceptance contract on this sample set

headline: The pre-registered saturation gate (sat_mean > 0.33, demote suspect -> real) clears both persistent false positives 057/058 and drives FPR to 0/63 in protocols A and C, but it simultaneously demotes genuine AI images 006/008/054/055 and therefore LOWERS accuracy in all three protocols (C 0.9678->0.9524, A 0.9244->0.9146, B 0.9258->0.9132), costing 23 true positives over 6 rounds under protocol C. It must not be wired into production.

decision.verdict_en: This gate must NOT be wired into production.
decision.classification: measured negative result + methodological impossibility proof
reasons: AI recall is not preserved: the gate converts genuine AI images 006/008/054/055 from suspect to real, costing 23 true-positive instances over 6 rounds under protocol C (19 under A, 21 under B).
The accuracy floor is met by no protocol: C 0.9678->0.9524, A 0.9244->0.9146, B 0.9258->0.9132; every one of the 6 rounds is worse or unchanged.
The trade is unfavourable on its own terms: removing 2 false positives costs 4 distinct AI true positives, i.e. the gate pays more recall than the FPR problem it repairs.
The entire measured benefit rests on exactly two images: with 057/058 removed the gate has no false positive left to remove and its mean accuracy delta is -0.0271 / -0.0299 / -0.0328 (A/B/C).

No flat threshold can satisfy the contract on this set: AI 054 (sat_mean 0.3933) is more saturated than the real false positive 058 (sat_mean 0.3501), so any threshold low enough to flip 058 also flips 054; any threshold high enough to spare all four AI images (> 0.4262) cannot flip 058.

The only thresholds that clear both false positives without AI recall loss are bands fitted to these exact 119 values (e.g. 0.33 < sat_mean < 0.39 plus sat_mean > 0.50), which the pre-registration protocol forbids.
decision.reversal_condition: This decision is reversible only by new evidence, not by re-tuning: a pre-registered, non-flat, multi-variable signal evaluated on a held-out set that contains real near-shot high-saturation images as a named sub-domain.
decision.admissible_form_if_ever_wanted: An optional fusion-layer config key defaulting to DISABLED, e.g. content_gate={'enabled': false, 'type': 'sat_mean_gt', 'threshold': 0.33}, carrying the measured cost above. No such change is made by this task.

demotions_and_ai_true_positive_loss.cost_interpretation: every demoted genuine AI image becomes a false negative; every demoted real image is a false positive removed

unsatisfiability_proof.claim: No single flat (univariate) threshold on sat_mean can both clear the false positive 058 and keep the AI true positives, therefore the gate's acceptance contract is unsatisfiable on this sample set - this is a property of the data, not of the implementation.
argument: The gate flips every sample with sat_mean > t from suspect to real.
If t <= sat_mean(058) = 0.3501, then 058 is flipped - but so is 054 (0.3933), which is a genuine AI image, so AI recall is lost.
If t > sat_mean(055) = 0.4262 (the largest of the four AI images), no AI image is flipped - but 058 (0.3501) is no longer flipped either, so the false positive survives.
There is no t in between: the AI samples' saturation values straddle the real false positive's value, i.e. the class-conditional supports overlap on this one variable.
Therefore flat thresholding on sat_mean cannot satisfy 'clear 057 and 058' AND 'preserve AI recall' simultaneously - the contract is unsatisfiable, not merely unmet.

only_escape_hatches_and_why_they_are_ina.why_inadmissible: fitted to these exact 119 values; the pre-registration forbids fitting the gate on the evaluation set
the archived grid sweep (optimistic_bias=true) shows the accuracy-optimal threshold 0.44 clears 057 but leaves 058 flagged; no grid point clears both while keeping the floor

unsatisfiability_proof.archived_statement: The AI images 006/008/054/055 have sat_mean 0.3933..0.4262, i.e. 054 is MORE saturated than the real false positive 058 (0.3501). A flat threshold low enough to flip 058 therefore also flips 054, and any threshold high enough to spare all four AI images (> 0.4262) can no longer flip 058. Only a band fitted to these exact values (e.g. 0.33 < sat_mean < 0.39, plus sat_mean > 0.50 for 057) clears both false positives without AI recall loss, and such a band is by construction fitted to the evaluation set.

forced_control_without_057_058.definition: identical protocols replayed on the sample set with seq 057 and seq 058 REMOVED (n=117; 61 real, 56 AI). Every threshold is held fixed at its full-set value so the only thing that changes is the presence of the two images.
forced_control_without_057_058.conclusion: With 057/058 removed the gate has no false positive left to remove: the false-positive count is unchanged and its only effect is lost AI recall. The whole measured benefit of the gate is therefore scoped to those two images - exactly the generalisation risk the pre-registration was meant to expose.
forced_control_without_057_058.reading: false-positive instances are unchanged (0->0 for A and C; 8->8 for B) while accuracy falls, so after deleting the two images there is no benefit left - only cost. The gate's entire measured gain is scoped to 057/058, i.e. it is a 2-sample effect, not a generalisable detector improvement.

optimistic_threshold_sweep_disclosure.warning: OPTIMISTIC UPPER BOUND ONLY. These thresholds were chosen by looking at the 119 labelled samples, so their scores are selection-biased and are NOT a deployable result. The pre-registered headline is threshold 0.33.
optimistic_threshold_sweep_disclosure.why_no_flat_threshold_satisfies_the_cont: The accuracy-optimal flat threshold on this grid (0.44) clears only 057 and leaves the false positive 058 in place; every threshold low enough to clear BOTH 057 and 058 (<= 0.35) also demotes AI images and drops protocol C accuracy to 0.9524, i.e. below the 0.9678 floor. No flat threshold on this grid clears both false positives while keeping the floor.
optimistic_threshold_sweep_disclosure.why_no_flat_threshold_rescues_the_gate: The AI images 006/008/054/055 have sat_mean 0.3933..0.4262, i.e. 054 is MORE saturated than the real false positive 058 (0.3501). A flat threshold low enough to flip 058 therefore also flips 054, and any threshold high enough to spare all four AI images (> 0.4262) can no longer flip 058. Only a band fitted to these exact values (e.g. 0.33 < sat_mean < 0.39, plus sat_mean > 0.50 for 057) clears both false positives without AI recall loss, and such a band is by construction fitted to the evaluation set.

verdict.explanation: The pre-registered gate clears both persistent false positives and drives the false-positive count to 0, but it also demotes genuine AI images 006/008/054/055 (sat_mean 0.3933..0.4262), so AI recall falls and accuracy drops below the 0.9678 floor in every protocol (C 0.9678->0.9524, A 0.9244->0.9146, B 0.9258->0.9132). The optimistic (fitted) sweep shows the same trade-off cannot be avoided by re-choosing the flat threshold: the accuracy-optimal value clears only 057 and leaves 058 flagged.
verdict.recommendation: Do NOT wire this gate into the production fusion layer. It is a measured negative result: removing 2 false positives costs 4 AI true positives, a worse trade than the 2/63 = 3.17% FPR it repairs, and the whole benefit rests on exactly two images. If a decision-layer override is wanted anyway, the only admissible form is an optional fusion-layer config key that is OFF by default (see the integration note in repo/reports/decision_gate_validation.json); it must carry the measured cost above.

honesty_statement: The gate's entire measured benefit on this set comes from seq 057 and seq 058. With those two images removed (control) the gate's mean accuracy delta is A=-0.0271, B=-0.0299, C=-0.0328 - i.e. no gain, and any residual movement is pure loss from demoting genuine AI images. A 2-sample effect inside a 63-sample real class cannot be shown to generalise: the gate is a pre-registered, falsifiable intervention whose evidence is two images, not a validated detector improvement.

brief_claims: at the 2-false-positive budget the OOF accuracy is ~0.9678 and FPR is 2/63 = 3.17%
a gate sat_mean > 0.33 selects 4 AI images and 3 real images (057, 058, 077); 077 is already correctly classified today and 057/058 are flagged in ALL 6 rounds

That operating point costs 1.80 AI images per round on average (accuracy 0.9244).

replacement_directions.title: 缩小分母的不确定性 (shrink the denominator uncertainty) instead of repairing single samples
replacement_directions.rationale: the <=3% guardrail cannot be established with n_real=63: 1 FP = 1.59% and the Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound at 0 FP already exceeds 3% (see repo/reports/baseline_improvement.json::statistical_guardrails). Enlarging the labelled real class is the only route that makes the guardrail claimable.
concrete_actions: collect a held-out real set large enough that one false positive no longer moves the metric by 1.59 points (>= a few hundred images)
report FPR as k/N counts plus an exact binomial CI on that larger set
keep 057/058 in the set as documented hard negatives rather than deleting them

replacement_directions.title: 提升 AI 类在该子域的判别力 (raise AI-class discrimination in that sub-domain)
replacement_directions.rationale: 057/058 are real near-shot high-saturation food/drink photos; the frozen detector's score on them is not a threshold artefact (pooled OOF logits 8.4730 and 3.5481 are the two largest real scores in the whole set). The defect is that this sub-domain is absent from the training distribution.
concrete_actions: targeted negative mining: add real near-shot food/drink/life-scene photos to the negative class and retrain, so the sub-domain is represented rather than patched
build an explicit acquisition-state channel (hand-held close-up detection: dof/saturation/sharpness) as a separate routing signal with its own calibrated threshold, pre-registered
for the AI side, add an independent channel for flat white-background documents (OCR text consistency / stroke-edge residuals) - the sub-domain where 003/029/030 leak through

replacement_directions.title: 若仍需要决策层覆盖，只能用预注册的多变量信号
replacement_directions.rationale: a flat univariate threshold is provably unsatisfiable here (see unsatisfiability_proof).
concrete_actions: pre-register the full feature vector and the decision rule before looking at any label
fit it only on training folds / a genuinely held-out set, never on the 119
publish the measured cost alongside the benefit in the same table
keep any production hook DISABLED by default and document the measured loss

do_not_repeat: Do not re-run or re-tune the sat_mean > 0.33 gate to 'make it pass'; the failure is structural.
Do not report 'FPR is now 0/63' from this gate as an improvement - the same run loses 23 true positives over 6 rounds.
Do not present this negative result as a partial success, a proof of concept, or a robustness finding. It is a measured cost with no admissible benefit.
Do not delete 057/058 from the evaluation set to make the metrics look better; they are the documented hard negatives that define the problem.
